summary: Two issues: one high-severity unquoted-path bug, one missing error check.

findings.title: Unquoted path in cd target
findings.detail: If $target contains spaces the cd fails silently and the rsync runs against $PWD.

findings.title: Ignored error from db.Close()
findings.detail: The error returned from closing the database connection is not handled. This may mask connection cleanup failures.

findings.title: No test file added for this new package
findings.detail: New packages should include test coverage. Consider adding a cmd/worker/*_test.go file.
